title: typed-function Integration

tasks.description: Create MathTS typed instance - configure typed-function with MathTS-specific type registry and test functions
Register core types - add all MathTS types (number, Complex, Fraction, BigNumber, Matrix, Unit) to typed registry with proper test functions
Define type conversions - implement automatic conversions: number→Complex, number→BigNumber, Array→Matrix, etc.
Implement factory pattern - create FunctionRegistry class for dependency injection and lazy function creation
Dependency injection system - implement dependency resolution for inter-function references (e.g., multiply depends on add)
Test typed dispatch - verify all type combinations dispatch correctly, test conversion chains, test error handling

successCriteria: typed-function dispatches correctly for all MathTS types
Type conversions work automatically when needed
Error messages are informative for type mismatches
notes: Sprint 3 integrates typed-function for runtime type dispatch and implements the factory pattern for function creation with dependency injection. All 207 tests passing.
